answer: Tenure-gated privileges resist sybils: the right to grade, vote, or settle unlocks only after an identity has been active and honest for a minimum number of epochs — no instant mirror of an established account. A swarm spun up today can echo all it likes but holds no privileged power until each account has aged, like a sonnet that only earns its final line in time. An attacker must pre-age every fake for epochs before it is useful, a long and exposed investment.
